## Decision and evidence layer

Describe the user decision, affected case, and evidence state.

## Changes

Describe the smallest reviewable change.

## Verification

- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests.
- [ ] `make lint typecheck coverage build verify` passes.
- [ ] No private/raw data, credential, or unsupported claim is included.
- [ ] Numerical claims come from a regenerated hashed evidence bundle.
- [ ] Model card, case catalog, changelog, and evidence ledger are updated if applicable.
- [ ] User-facing HTML was inspected for keyboard use, labels, contrast, and overflow.
